title: quassia simaruba
intro: Quassia simaruba, commonly known as the Palo de Brasil or Yellow Wood, is a plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which help to alleviate digestive issues, reduce fever, and soothe skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Quassia simaruba include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce nausea, and act as a natural insecticide. The bioactive constituents of this plant include quassin, simarrubin, and other sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
